role: Voice service configuration factory for Deepgram speech-to-text and Elevenlabs text-to-speech integrations
detail: Exports a single NestJS config factory `voiceConfig` that provides environment-driven configuration for two voice vendors. Deepgram API key, Elevenlabs API key, Elevenlabs voice ID (defaults to '21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM'), and Elevenlabs model ID (defaults to 'eleven_turbo_v2_5') are all read from environment variables with sensible defaults where provided. No runtime logic; pure configuration structure used by dependency injection.
gotchas: Deepgram API key has no default and falls back to empty string if unset; Elevenlabs API key similarly has no default; dependent services must validate these are set before use.
